name: qkd_pv_ctl_tb1
purpose: KVPLAN 1815 (Q-KV 10-16): the PV16 pair control tile for the trunked pair successor qkd_pvw_die_t (tools/qwen_kv_die/pv_trunk_gen.py): identical to ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl (a72) except TRUNK_D=54 / FLAG_D=58 (the column-flag check slot moves by 112 edges, out_age by 54; wage 6 -> 8 b). Same outline / pins / layer cap as a72.

job.purpose: KV-BOOTAGE 10-19 (coordinator decision, lanes/KVR-DERIVE.md re-harden spec): boot-programmable pair FIRST_INPUT_AGE. ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_tb = ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_t with FIRST_INPUT_AGE from cfg_fia (sealed die cfg, pre-boot image target 10; no handshake): every FIRSTI constant is a registered constant from the pinned word (k_*), bound 127 (die-derived 107-108 vs the hard 95). +8 pins (cfg_fia, E face). Same outline 43.2 x 43.2. Edge-for-edge = ctl_t #(FIRST_INPUT_AGE a) (lockstep bench, results/rtl/kv_bootage_1019). KVPLAN3 0230 10-17: same tile as qkd_pv_ctl_t_d54f58 (outline 43.2x43.

benches.name: lint
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_tb #(.FIRST_INPUT_AGE(127), .RESET_PIN(1), .MUT(0), .TRUNK_D(54), .FLAG_D(58)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_pair.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_tb.sv && echo lint-ok

reroute_reason.why: KV-BOOTAGE: boot-programmable FIRST_INPUT_AGE (cfg_fia pin); the d54f58a95 view hard-codes 95 while the die derives 107-108

pin_regs.reason: the RTL already registers every data port at the module boundary (ot_qwen_tp8_pv_col: pv/pe/cmd -> v_r/e_r/c_r, y/y_valid/fault are flops; ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl: every input *_r, every output a flop; only the constant pair_id strap is unregistered) and the bench-measured static calendar includes those stages (P = 22 + NQ + 113, results/arch/qwen_attention_rate_1015/receipt.json, 53/53 exact); a flow-inserted second stage would add 1 cycle the compiler calendar does not have. io_flop_at_pins anchors the RTL pin flops (recipe 2).

structural_change: KV-BOOTAGE 10-19 (coordinator decision, lanes/KVR-DERIVE.md re-harden spec): boot-programmable pair FIRST_INPUT_AGE. ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_tb = ot_qwen_tp8_pv_wide_ctl_t with FIRST_INPUT_AGE from cfg_fia (sealed die cfg, pre-boot image target 10; no handshake): every FIRSTI constant is a registered constant from the pinned word (k_*), bound 127 (die-derived 107-108 vs the hard 95). +8 pins (cfg_fia, E face). Same outline 43.2 x 43.2. Edge-for-edge = ctl_t #(FIRST_INPUT_AGE a) (lockstep bench, results/rtl/kv_bootage_1019). KVPLAN3 0230 10-17: same tile as qkd_pv_ctl_t_d54f58 (outline 43.2x43.2, M5, RTL pin flops) at FIRST_INPUT_AGE 95: the kvs13l geometry (DW 950.4, PV_T pair, header/request to the control tile through the hub channel) needs WP + O = 77..81 die relay edges per V port (pvin 12.9 mm / 38 stages + pvrq 14.1 mm / 38 on the far ports), so every port is equalised to PV_W 82 -> RL = 4+82+0+8 = 94, FIRST_INPUT_AGE = RL+1 = 95. Parameter-only change of the calendar constant; 0 cycles added in the tile.
